purpose: Test a self-adjoint field-aligned diffusion closure that preserves global vector flux and suppresses the local focusing diagnosed in P0655.

candidate.graph: symmetric one-cell bilinear links along plus/minus Newtonian direction, with conductance from the inherited physical taper and squared tidal trace length

cross_validation.fold_definition: reuse exact P0645 five source-family-stratified folds
cross_validation.selection: none; the sole amplitude-one self-adjoint diffusion field is scored

claim_boundary: The graph Laplacian is symmetric and positive semidefinite; the identity coefficient is fixed to one and is not fitted.
The squared tidal trace length and physical taper are inherited; no new distance or support scale is introduced.
The graph is unchanged by reversing every Newtonian field direction and its row sums enforce vector-flux conservation.
All lens scores use spent RX J2129 images and cannot validate the law.
A failed gate rejects this diffusion closure rather than authorizing diffusion-strength, amplitude, support, or path-length retuning.
A pass authorizes numerical and component-map robustness before any blind P0633/P0640 opening.
The projected graph closure is a discretized transport hypothesis, not yet a covariant spacetime action.
